editorNote: Rocket Lab, Alibaba, gold and bitcoin all moved late in the week. Every item rests on headlines alone, so details are limited to what the outlets reported.

stories.headline: Rocket Lab climbs 13% in a rebound, Seeking Alpha reports; Stocktwits says it is protesting Blue Origin's $700M NASA Mars award
stories.summary: A Seeking Alpha headline says Rocket Lab rose 13%, rebounding from recent losses. A Stocktwits headline says the company protested Blue Origin's $700 million NASA Mars deal and called the review 'punitive'. The headlines give no further detail.
stories.whyItMatters: Rocket Lab is a watchlist holding, and the headlines point to a sharp one-day rise alongside a reported contract protest.

sourceLinks.title: Rocket Lab climbs 13%, rebounding from recent losses (RKLB:NASDAQ) - Seeking Alpha
RKLB Stock Slips Overnight: Rocket Lab Protests Blue Origin’s $700M NASA Mars Deal, Calls Review ‘Punitive’ - Stocktwits

stories.headline: Gold holds the $4,000 level, Kitco says, as StoneX flags a 17% fall from the peak
stories.summary: Kitco's headline says gold held $4,000 support while strong US jobs data and inflation risks threaten a recovery. A StoneX headline says a 17% plunge threatens the multi-year uptrend.
stories.whyItMatters: Two forecasters' headlines frame the $4,000 level as the line separating a correction from a deeper break.

sourceLinks.title: Gold price holds critical $4,000 support, but strong U.S. jobs data and inflation risks threaten recovery - Kitco
Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD 17% Plunge Threatens Multi-Year Uptrend - StoneX

stories.headline: StoneX says bitcoin's 12.5% plunge nears critical support
stories.summary: A StoneX headline says BTC/USD's 12.5% drop is approaching critical support. The headline gives no price levels.
stories.whyItMatters: The note describes bitcoin's recent fall as large enough for the analyst to flag a support test.

sourceLinks.title: Bitcoin Price Forecast: BTC/USD 12.5% Plunge Nears Critical Support - StoneX

stories.headline: Alibaba ADR outperforms the market on a strong Friday, MarketWatch says; Yahoo Finance notes a 12% weekly gain
stories.summary: A MarketWatch headline says Alibaba's ADR outperformed on a strong trading day. A Yahoo Finance headline says it gained 12% in a week while the Nasdaq fell.
stories.whyItMatters: Alibaba moved against the broader Nasdaq this week, according to the headlines.

sourceLinks.title: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. ADR outperforms market on strong trading day - MarketWatch

stories.headline: Motley Fool asks whether Google's new cryptocurrency push is a reason to buy Alphabet
stories.summary: A Motley Fool piece, syndicated on Yahoo Finance, examines a new Google cryptocurrency push. The headline is all we read, so the nature of the push is not described here.
stories.whyItMatters: It shows crypto-related activity at a watchlist company drawing commentary; the headline reports no disclosed financial effect.
